title: Fragmented Portrait with Cosmic Metallic Cubes
summary: Surreal portrait of a young man whose face and torso fragment into floating chrome-and-bronze 3D cubes against a warm nebular void, blending fine art photography with octane-render aesthetics.
prompt: A handsome young man with curly brown hair and green eyes, resting his chin on his hand with a thoughtful expression. Surreal deconstruction: the subject's face and upper body are fragmented into floating 3D metallic cubes. Chrome and bronze mirrored surfaces on cubes reflect parts of the subject and a cosmic background. Dust particles and small debris float in dark, warm-toned nebular space. Cinematic side-lighting with high contrast and golden hour highlights. Hyper-realistic digital art, fine art photography, octane render, 8k resolution.
